ROUND 2 REASSESSMENT OF THE THREE FINDINGS, each judged on the corrected delta alone. FINDING 1 RESOLVED: CHANGELOG.md now carries an [Unreleased] entry for this Request (54d315f) that names all five changes in the operator voice, states that who is let into each page has not changed while which of the three the nav offers follows her rights, names the re-hashed stylesheet, and corrects the stale sentence of the nav-quick-actions entry to point at the new one. FINDING 2 RESOLVED, MECHANISM AND READING BOTH: [data-nav-collapsed] .sidebar takes overflow: visible (css:1091), so the scroll box belongs to the open geometry alone and the folded revealed word at left: 100 percent is no longer clipped sideways; .sidebar takes z-index: 20 (css:1012), a stated band above the positioned page content (.column and .issue-card at z-index auto, a travelling lane at 2) and below every overlay the stylesheet declares (modal 50, lane menu 60, keyboard help 100, drag ghost 200), which closes the second cause ADR-NAV-POLISH-004 found and which my round-1 finding had not seen - position: sticky already made the rail a stacking context, so the flyout own z-index: 30 ordered the word only inside the rail. The comment that stated the refuted premise is rewritten. The reading my finding asked for exists and is not a layout-box reading: law L8 walks the keyboard onto a named member of the narrowed nav over a long board scrolled to its bottom, asserts the word is present, in the layout and at least 4 by 4 px, asserts it is drawn BESIDE the rail and OVERLAPS at least one lane or card (so the law cannot hold where nothing could cover it), and then asserts the centre of the word box answers the word itself rather than an ancestor, a column or a card. Two examples cover the main group and the group at the foot; one row asserts the shortcut overlay covers the rail centre (the other end of the band); one row asserts the open nav draws no word over the board (the bound). The oracle ran RED on these rows before the stylesheet fix and green after. FINDING 3 RESOLVED: NavSection::offered_mark (nav.rs:39-64) maps Invites and Tokens to Home when the rail own identity read reports no workspace admin, is called once inside resolved() after the identity is read (nav.rs:272), is total over the five variants with no wildcard arm so a future variant breaks the build, is pure and infallible, and the new unit test walks the whole closed product of five sections by two rights values, asserting for each pair the reconciled section, that exactly one predicate is current, and that the marked member is one the rail offers. The Quint invariant markNeverEmpty carries the design claim with a resolve=none mutant that reproduces the zero-mark trace, and ADR-NAV-POLISH-005 records the public reachability of that branch as BLOCKED with an indeterminate runtime rather than PASS. THE ROUND-1 RETAINED DESIGN FINDING IS ALSO CLOSED, by new authority with provenance: the user decided on 2026-11-20 that a rail control is exempt from the 1.4.11 boundary in EVERY layout (ADR-NAV-POLISH-006, superseded in part by -007), the exemption is re-keyed from a drawn word to DOM containment in the rail aside, and the two layouts that drew no word now have their own rows in both palettes. That migration is authority-driven and strictly MORE discriminating than what it replaced: the rail rows assert the quietest rail control computes BELOW 3:1, so a green is the exemption doing work rather than a quiet pass; the floor is redefined from a glyph-only count (which -007 shows had no member left outside the rail) to at least one control outside the rail actually read, anchored on .lane-menu-trigger, which carries its own 1 px border and MEETS 3:1 - a true negative rather than a control the law must forgive; the phone row asserts that NO ratio is read there and that the glyph is present, so a clipped sliver is never measured; and the word reading now blends a translucent ink over the surface behind it before computing the ratio, which answers retained oracle finding F4.

diagnostic: ACCEPTED, round 2 of 2, reassessing only the corrected delta 93a2d11..27dd9af and keeping every round-1 judgment that delta does not touch. All three blocking findings are resolved and the round-1 retained design finding is closed by new user authority. ONE: CHANGELOG.md carries the [Unreleased] entry for this Request, names all five changes in the operator voice, and the stale sentence of the earlier nav entry is corrected. TWO: the folded geometry takes overflow: visible back, so the scroll box belongs to the open rail alone and the revealed word is no longer clipped sideways; the rail takes an explicit z-index: 20 band above the positioned page content and below every declared overlay, which closes the second cause ADR-NAV-POLISH-004 found and my round-1 finding had not seen; and law L8 reads the word WHERE IT IS PAINTED - keyboard walk onto a named member of the narrowed nav, over a long board scrolled to its bottom, with the word asserted drawn beside the rail and overlapping a lane before the centre hit test is taken, plus one row for the overlay end of the band and one for the open-nav bound. That reading was RED before the stylesheet fix and green after, which is exactly the discrimination my finding said no lane had. THREE: NavSection::offered_mark reconciles the mark with the offer in the one place that already resolves the rail identity, is total over the five variants with no wildcard arm, and the new unit test walks the whole closed product of five sections by two rights values asserting the reconciled section, exactly one current predicate and that the mark is an offered member; the Quint invariant markNeverEmpty carries the design claim with a mutant that reproduces the zero-mark trace, and ADR-NAV-POLISH-005 records that branch public reachability as BLOCKED with an indeterminate runtime rather than claiming PASS. THE THEME-LANE MIGRATION IS AUTHORITY-DRIVEN AND MORE DISCRIMINATING, not accommodation: the user decided the exemption holds in every layout (ADR-006, -007), it is re-keyed from a drawn word to DOM containment in the rail aside, the two icon-only layouts gain their own rows in both palettes, the rail rows assert the quietest rail control computes BELOW 3:1 so a green is the exemption doing work, the floor is re-anchored on a control outside the rail that is actually read and MEETS 3:1, the phone row asserts no ratio is read where no word is drawn and that the glyph is there, and a translucent ink is now blended over its surface before the ratio. VERIFICATION IS SUFFICIENT AND WAS NOT REPEATED: only docs/feature/ui-nav-polish/runs/craft.S1.json changed after the host complete native run at 9179ae0, so that run applies unchanged to HEAD 27dd9af and every selected target is a strict subset of it - FOUNDRY_XTASK_INCLUDE_DOCKER=1 cargo xtask ci, exit 0, all gates green, 2319 of 2319 scenarios, with the five new rows verified present and green in the log; the reviewer additionally recomputed the stylesheet sha256 itself and confirmed the prefix and all four readers. RETAINED NON-BLOCKING, owner oracle, none of them a promised outcome and none blocking completion: the outside-rail floor asserts only that the reading is non-empty; the phone glyph guard reads DOM presence rather than paint; the phone scenario title names one control while the row checks two; and labelCentreAnswered cannot by itself separate a clipped word from a covered one, which the step comments state honestly. CAPABILITY LIMITS: typesafe unavailable (no API key in this environment, exit 3), so every judgment here is the reviewer own and no producer judgment was consumed; the project has no test-impact selector, so selection is the mechanical diff enumeration recorded in observation R5. One residue the design records rather than hides: a folded rail taller than the window now leaves its last members outside the window, recorded with the crafter in ADR-NAV-POLISH-003 consequences instead of claimed as a satisfied promise - no row of this candidate claims otherwise, so it is not a finding.
